prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A chubby, cartoonish orange tabby cat sitting upright on a plain pastel-yellow background, drawn in the glossy 3D-rendered style of a cheap mobile-game mascot: oversized round head about as big as its pear-shaped body, tiny stubby arms and legs, smooth soft-plastic-looking fur with no individual hairs, huge white bulging eyes with small black pupils rolled slightly upward in gleeful madness, thick raised eyebrows, and an enormous wide-open laughing mouth stretched almost ear to ear — dark pink cavern inside, two tiny white fangs on top, a fat curled pink tongue, cheeks puffed into round balls.
